The paper-local source/paper.xml symlink resolves to a Beilstein RSS/landing feed rather than article NXML; article evidence was recovered from the packet OA package NXML/PDF and landed PMC XML.

Figure 3 and prose support qualitative MCF-10A selectivity/toxicity statements, but exact normal-cell 50% death thresholds in database rows are not available as source table values and are retained as conflicts.
Staged supplementary assets were checked and are article/database/reference HTML landing pages, not separate local XLSX/PDF data tables needed for Table 1 activity or database reconciliation.
Flow cytometry and AFM support necrotic death/membrane perturbation for Dec-NH2 only; no molecular target or generalized analog mechanism is claimed.
